introSection.heading: Two Distinct Approaches to Elevated Cruising on Princess
introSection.p1: Princess Cruises offers two premium accommodation experiences designed to make a voyage feel more elevated: Reserve Collection and The Sanctuary Collection. Both add exclusive touches beyond a standard stateroom, but they are not the same product.
introSection.p2: Reserve Collection focuses on an upgraded stateroom experience, with a premium location, exclusive Reserve Dining, and selected priority services. The Sanctuary Collection is a more comprehensive private-retreat experience, combining selected premium staterooms with access to dedicated onboard spaces, exclusive dining, personalized service, and Princess Premier benefits.
introSection.p3: The right choice depends on the ship, the stateroom category, the amenities you value, and how much of your time you expect to spend enjoying the ship.

reserveDeepDive.title: What Is the Reserve Collection?
reserveDeepDive.subtitle: Premium Staterooms with Expedited Dining and Thoughtful Onboard Touches
reserveDeepDive.description: Reserve Collection is Princess Cruises' premium stateroom category for guests who want additional comfort, dining privileges, and selected priority services without necessarily choosing a full luxury-style onboard package. It is particularly associated with qualifying Mini-Suites and Suites. A standard Mini-Suite does not automatically qualify: the Reserve Collection designation must be selected when booking.

benefits.title: Exclusive Reserve Collection Dining
benefits.description: A dedicated dining area with dedicated waitstaff and expedited seating in the main dining venue. Reservations are not required for the exclusive dining experience.

benefits.title: Premium Stateroom Location
benefits.description: Selected cabins are positioned in more desirable midship or scenic locations for smoother sailing and optimal views.

benefits.title: Priority Embarkation & Disembarkation
benefits.description: Selected priority check-in lines and expedited debarkation services at the beginning and end of the voyage.

benefits.title: Welcome Wine Setup
benefits.description: A complimentary in-room bottle of wine delivered on embarkation day to toast your departure.

benefits.title: Priority Specialty Dining Reservations
benefits.description: Earlier booking windows and concierge assistance for sought-after specialty restaurants like Crown Grill and Sabatini's.

benefits.title: Evening Canapés
benefits.description: Complimentary premium evening canapés delivered fresh to your stateroom upon request.

benefits.title: Upgraded Bathrobes & Linens
benefits.description: Enhanced plush bathrobes, premium bath products, and upgraded pillow options.

benefits.title: Mini-Suite Comforts
benefits.description: Qualifying Mini-Suites retain all standard features, including a separate living area, full sofa bed, and private veranda.

reserveDeepDive.summary: Reserve Collection is a good fit for guests who value a more convenient dining routine, a prime cabin location, and thoughtful in-room amenities without paying for top-deck private club access.

sanctuaryDeepDive.title: What Is The Sanctuary Collection?
sanctuaryDeepDive.subtitle: A Ship-Within-a-Ship Resort Experience with Exclusive Spaces and All-Inclusive Perks
sanctuaryDeepDive.description: The Sanctuary Collection is Princess Cruises' more comprehensive premium accommodation experience. It brings together selected staterooms and suites with exclusive spaces, elevated dining, personalized service, and a broader set of included benefits. Rather than focusing mainly on the cabin and dining privileges, it creates a private, resort-style sanctuary throughout the voyage.

benefits.title: Sanctuary Club Access
benefits.description: Entry to an exclusive top-deck adults-only retreat (ages 16+) featuring a private pool, plush loungers, attentive bar service, a dedicated culinary menu, and private cabanas (available for reservation).

benefits.title: Sanctuary Restaurant Access
benefits.description: A private restaurant with a custom chef's menu, dedicated waitstaff, and distinct venue atmosphere. No reservations required.

benefits.title: Princess Premier Included
benefits.description: Eligible bookings include the full Princess Premier package—covering unlimited premium drinks up to $20, multi-device MedallionNet Max Wi-Fi, crew appreciation, specialty dining, photo packages, and shore excursion credits.

benefits.title: Elevated Priority Services
benefits.description: Priority embarkation, dedicated port lines, priority tendering, and personalized guest service assistance.

benefits.title: Elevated Stateroom Amenities
benefits.description: Custom bath products, luxury robes and slippers, and an enhanced turndown experience.

benefits.title: Suite-Specific Privileges
benefits.description: Sanctuary suite guests receive additional suite benefits, including access to the exclusive Suite Lounge on participating vessels.

benefits.title: Butler Service on Eligible Suites
benefits.description: Dedicated butler service provided exclusively with eligible Sanctuary suites for unpacking, private dining coordination, and personalized itinerary support.

sanctuaryDeepDive.adultsOnlyNote: The Sanctuary Club is an adults-only space for guests aged 16 and over. It is distinct from the Sanctuary Collection stateroom category and should not be confused with the separately bookable Sanctuary spa day-passes found on other Princess vessels.

diningAndSpacesShowcase.title: The Biggest Difference: Dining and Private Spaces
diningAndSpacesShowcase.subtitle: Understanding how your daily routine changes between an enhanced main dining room and an exclusive private retreat.

features.title: Reserve Collection Dining
features.description: Reserve Collection guests enjoy a dedicated section within the ship's main dining venue. It offers expedited walk-in seating with no reservations needed, plus dedicated waitstaff and special daily culinary selections.

features.title: The Sanctuary Restaurant
features.description: A completely standalone, private restaurant reserved exclusively for Sanctuary Collection guests. It features an exclusive custom chef's menu, upscale intimate tables, and dedicated culinary teams with no reservations required.

features.title: The Sanctuary Club Top-Deck Retreat
features.description: The Sanctuary Collection unlocks access to The Sanctuary Club—a serene, adults-only sanctuary on the ship's top decks with a private swimming pool, hot tubs, comfortable daybeds, and beverage service away from the active central pool deck.

features.title: The Practical Distinction
features.description: Reserve Collection improves the dining and cabin experience within the ship's existing public environment. The Sanctuary Collection establishes a true 'ship-within-a-ship' enclave with a dedicated restaurant, private club lounge, and top-deck retreat.

premierDifference.title: Princess Premier: The Game-Changing Inclusions
premierDifference.subtitle: How the included package dramatically alters the financial calculation between Reserve and Sanctuary.
premierDifference.description: One of the most significant distinctions is the package included with Sanctuary Collection bookings. Eligible Sanctuary Collection reservations include Princess Premier at no extra charge, whereas Reserve Collection staterooms do not automatically include it.

premierInclusions.title: Beverage Package
premierInclusions.description: Up to 15 premium beverages per day up to $20 each (champagne, fine wine, craft cocktails, top-shelf spirits, specialty coffee, and fountain drinks).

premierInclusions.title: Specialty & Casual Dining
premierInclusions.description: Included dining experiences at acclaimed specialty restaurants and casual dining venues across the ship.

premierInclusions.title: MedallionNet Max Wi-Fi
premierInclusions.description: Fastest available satellite Wi-Fi connection for up to four devices per guest simultaneously.

premierInclusions.title: Crew Appreciation
premierInclusions.description: Daily onboard gratuities fully prepaid for stateroom attendants, dining waitstaff, and support crew.

premierInclusions.title: Shore Excursion Credits
premierInclusions.description: Applicable shore excursion credits to explore ports of call with curated guided tours.

premierInclusions.title: Digital & Print Photos
premierInclusions.description: Professional photography package with digital downloads and selected souvenir prints.

premierInclusions.title: Reserved Theater Seating
premierInclusions.description: Prime reserved seating sections for headline production shows in the Princess Theater.

premierInclusions.title: OceanNow Delivery & Room Service
premierInclusions.description: Complimentary on-demand delivery to anywhere on the ship and waived room service delivery fees.

premierDifference.financialTakeaway: Princess Premier normally costs $105 per person per day ($110/day on Sun and Star Princess). On a seven-night cruise for two guests, this package alone is worth approximately $1,470 to $1,540. If you planned on purchasing Premier anyway, that value effectively offsets a large portion of the Sanctuary Collection fare premium.

fleetRollout.title: Which Princess Ships Offer Each Collection?
fleetRollout.subtitle: The availability of both collections is evolving as Princess expands The Sanctuary Collection across its Royal-class and Sphere-class fleet.
fleetRollout.intro: Reserve Collection has traditionally been offered on Princess ships outside Sun Princess and Star Princess. As The Sanctuary Collection rolls out fleetwide, the two experiences are becoming available on different stateroom categories and departure dates.

table.title: The Sanctuary Collection Fleet Rollout Schedule

fleetRollout.scheduleNote: These dates represent the first phase of Princess' broader fleet modernization initiative. Staterooms may be bookable under the new collection before the onboard transformation commences. Always verify your sailing date against the onboard launch timeline.

You prefer intimate, dedicated restaurant dining over the busier main dining room

recommendation.title: Reserve Collection vs. The Sanctuary Collection: Which Should You Choose?
recommendation.p1: Choose Reserve Collection if you want an elevated stateroom with exclusive dining privileges, priority services, and thoughtful in-room extras without automatically bundling the full Princess Premier package. It offers convenience and prime cabin positioning at a moderate price premium.
recommendation.p2: Choose The Sanctuary Collection if you want a complete luxury resort experience at sea—combining private top-deck relaxation at The Sanctuary Club, custom chef menus at Sanctuary Restaurant, dedicated concierge service, and all the benefits of Princess Premier included with your stateroom.
recommendation.p3: If comparing both options on the same ship, request the total fare difference for your departure date and cabin category. Subtract the value of the included Princess Premier package ($105–$110 per person per day) to calculate the true cost of The Sanctuary Club and private restaurant access.

faqs.question: Is Reserve Collection the same as The Sanctuary Collection?
faqs.answer: No. Reserve Collection focuses on premium stateroom location, exclusive Reserve Dining within the main dining venue, and selected priority services. The Sanctuary Collection adds private onboard spaces (The Sanctuary Club), a dedicated restaurant (Sanctuary Restaurant), personalized service, and Princess Premier benefits with eligible bookings.

faqs.question: Does Reserve Collection include Princess Premier?
faqs.answer: No. Princess Premier is not automatically included with a Reserve Collection booking. Guests can purchase it separately. By contrast, eligible Sanctuary Collection bookings include Princess Premier as a built-in package benefit.

faqs.question: Does The Sanctuary Collection include specialty dining?
faqs.answer: Yes. Eligible Sanctuary Collection bookings include the Princess Premier package, which covers specialty dining meals at venues like Crown Grill, Sabatini's, or The Catch by Rudi, subject to ship availability and package terms.

faqs.question: Can I access the Sanctuary Club with Reserve Collection?
faqs.answer: No. Reserve Collection does not provide access to The Sanctuary Club. Entry to the private pool, cabanas, and retreat deck is an exclusive privilege of eligible Sanctuary Collection accommodation.

faqs.question: Is The Sanctuary Collection available on every Princess ship?
faqs.answer: Not yet. It launched on Sun Princess and Star Princess, and is actively expanding across Royal Princess, Regal Princess, Discovery Princess, Sky Princess, and Enchanted Princess through mid-2027. Check the specific rollout date for your chosen ship.

faqs.question: Is every Mini-Suite part of Reserve Collection or The Sanctuary Collection?
faqs.answer: No. Only designated qualifying Mini-Suites carry collection privileges. Standard Mini-Suites receive only the physical cabin layout without exclusive dining, club access, or collection amenities. Always verify the exact stateroom category name during booking.

faqs.question: Are all suites part of one of these collections?
faqs.answer: Princess assigns suites to either Reserve Collection or Sanctuary Collection depending on the ship. Sanctuary suites are offered on ships with the Sanctuary Collection infrastructure, while Reserve suites are offered on vessels where Reserve Collection operates.

faqs.question: Is The Sanctuary Collection adults-only?
faqs.answer: The Sanctuary Club retreat space is adults-only for guests aged 16 and over. However, The Sanctuary Collection itself is an accommodation and amenities category, not an adults-only cruise; families can book Sanctuary staterooms, though Club access is age-restricted.

faqs.question: Can I book The Sanctuary Collection on Royal Princess?
faqs.answer: Yes. Princess opened Sanctuary Collection bookings for Royal Princess on October 22, 2026, with the full onboard experience commencing on January 4, 2027 (and preview sailings announced from October 30, 2026).

faqs.question: Which collection offers better value?
faqs.answer: The Sanctuary Collection typically offers superior overall value if you planned to purchase Princess Premier ($105–$110 per person per day) and will use the private top-deck pool and dedicated restaurant. Reserve Collection is often better if you prefer a lower base fare, do not need an all-inclusive drinks/Wi-Fi bundle, and mainly value expedited dining.
